Team — forwarding ProcureCo's redline and the registration link. High priority onboarding; they want a PO week of 2/22. Please see my notes and proposed owner assignments below.

Quick context: ProcureCo is a mid-market SaaS company; they want to onboard via Ariba (link included). They attached an initial MSA redline with standard procurement asks. Sales needs a clean path to PO next week.

Proposed owners / asks:
- Legal (Priyom): review attached MSA redline and produce a redline response with the following buckets: data retention & purge, sub-processing clause, indemnity cap exposure, and confidentiality carve-outs. Please flag any commercial drifts that would require pricing or credit approvals.
- Finance (Marcus): provide Redwood's PO template and remit/bank confirmation. Also confirm if finance requires any invoice-specific fields for ProcureCo (tax id, remit-to formatted address, W-9/1099 items).
- Ops/Onboarding (Laura): confirm Ariba profile fields and whether Redwood should register as a supplier or ProcureCo will create the profile and invite us. If ProcureCo needs any certificates (insurance, tax forms), list them.

Attachments included for your review: ProcureCo_MSA_Redlines_v1.pdf; I also attached a blank Ariba requirements workbook I started (ProcureCo_Ariba_Requirements.xlsx).

Timeline suggestion:
- EOD Tue (2/16): legal initial pass and list of deal-breakers
- Wed (2/17): finance provides PO template + remit details
- Thu (2/18): Laura verifies registration flow and required docs
- Fri (2/19): Grace provides consolidated response to ProcureCo; aim for sign-off next week.

If anyone expects a longer lead time, call it out and we'll escalate.

Thanks — Grace

Attachments: ProcureCo_MSA_Redlines_v1.pdf; ProcureCo_Ariba_Requirements.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ProcureCo - Ariba onboarding + MSA redlines (ProcureCo)

Thanks for the heads-up, Grace — I reviewed ProcureCo_MSA_Redlines_v1.pdf. High level: we can accept most of their edits with carve-outs, but there are three clauses that need negotiation: indemnity cap (they want unlimited on IP claims), sub-processor flow-down that requires written consent for subcontractors, and a narrower definition of "Confidential Information" that would exclude derived model weights.

Planned actions:
- I'll build a redline response that explains our stance and proposes middle-ground language on indemnity and subprocessors. Expect draft by EOD Tue (2/16) morning update and final redline by EOD Tue.
- If they insist on unlimited indemnity or require on-prem data retention that conflicts with our retention policy, we'll need commercial approval (Grace: please flag to the buyer if that comes up).

Also, FYI to Finance: we'll attempt to avoid adding onerous insurance thresholds; typical ProcureCo asks are fine but if they push reseller-level indemnities escalate to Legal Ops.

- Priyom
